outcome: Turn the provider preflight ledger assertion from a claim about the repository being empty into a claim about the ledger function tolerating zero records, so that recording a real provider exercise no longer requires breaking the test that guards it.
non_goals: Do not weaken any of the ledger's refusal cases
Do not remove the real-tree assertion; restate it as the invariant that must hold at every commit

transitions.reason: V2-017 stopped before consuming any real invocation because a test pinned a transient state of the tree as a permanent invariant
